methodology: Player-stat archives retain original public Git commit times. Older game/TD archives retain model-issue timestamps and are snapshot research, not independently verified wager logs.
Published history and reconstructed walk-forward tests are separate cohorts. Older unavailable history is not invented.
Combined totals sum matching component means from the same issue time; prediction intervals are not added because their dependence is unknown.
Continuous error is measured in each stat’s native units; different stats are never pooled into one MAE. Bias is projected minus actual.
Baseline skill compares the model and rolling baseline on exactly the same rows. Missing baseline values remain unavailable.
80% interval coverage measures distribution calibration, not a bet win rate.
Moneyline calibration uses home-win probability conditional on no tie; tied games are not graded as binary wins/losses. TD probabilities include every archived player, not only successful picks.
First/last TD order is graded only when every scoring touchdown is resolved to a scorer. Passing TDs do not count as a QB anytime TD.
Official weekly player statistics are preferred; unresolved outcomes may use explicitly listed final ESPN box scores. Missing player stats are not filled with zero.
Sportsbook results use separately recorded lines and deterministic selections, not executed wagers. No ROI, closing-line value, or profitability proof is claimed.
